$comment: Single source of truth for packed state, thus never edit the generated files, edit this one and run `npm run gen:state` from vite/. the ci fails if the generated output drifts from this file.

RunState.description: Where the game as a whole is; replaces sniffing scene paths on the React side.

WorldMode.description: Which kind of world the player is in right now. A murder mystery moves between flat interior scenes and spatial sections, and both React and the ECS need to know which without guessing from the scene path.

JournalKind.description: What kind of fact a journal entry records. The journal is the run's memory: who spoke to whom, what was used on what, where the player has been. Each entry carries a ULID, so entries sort by when they happened without a clock field being trusted or compared.

PlayerFlags.description: Per frame player state! Packed because systems test these thousands of times a second; a bit test is a single AND against a register but overkill for now, damn safari.
